asset_issues.details: The specified sentinel-ai-hero.webp reference was absent; original prompt and original Spline scene were used.

An early mobile font readiness check was false. Added unmodified local Google-hosted TTF copies for all five weights and included OFL license; final checks confirm loaded faces on both viewports. Exact requested Google Fonts link retained.

notes: Only Sentinel AI was implemented. No agents, other sessions, deployment, push, or outbound messages.
Original remote Spline URL is used; a byte-for-byte local copy provides fallback if remote loading fails.
CTA destinations and linked section content were not specified; controls preserve requested presentation and interactions, with no invented backend or extra sections.
Software WebGL made initial unpaused screenshot capture time out. Final checks freeze requestAnimationFrame in the validation browser after scene initialization; production remains animated.
Hover state was verified; the recorded brightness value is the transition start while animation frames are frozen.
Vite reports the expected advisory chunk-size warning for the lazy-loaded Spline runtime.
Ready means available for review, not deployed.
